yaml.title: Research
yaml.subtitle: Projects across educational inequality, academic careers, and social networks
yaml.description-meta: Research projects by Matías Montero in education, inequality, gender, and social network analysis.

markdown.markdown:
::: {.page-lede} I work on collaborative projects that connect substantive questions about inequality with longitudinal, quantitative, and relational methods. The portfolio below highlights current and recent work. ::: ::: {.project-grid} ::: {.project-card .project-featured} DPhil research · 2024-present ### Networks and gender disparities across academic careers My doctoral research examines how co-authorship and research-funding networks shape gendered career trajectories among education researchers in Latin America. It brings together research-on-research, organisational context, and longitudinal network modelling. **Role:** Doctoral researcher
**Institution:** University of Oxford
**Supervisors:** Alis Oancea and Lars-Erik Malmberg longitudinal networks gender higher education ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025-present ### Choosing schools with a click Studies how parents and guardians appropriate information about Chile's School Admission System and how digital information shapes school choice. **Grant:** FONDECYT Regular 1250492
**Role:** Research Assistant · CIAE, Universidad de Chile ::: ::: {.project-card} 2023-present ### Gender segregation across knowledge areas Investigates the background, moderators, and consequences of gender segregation in Chilean academic secondary education. **Grant:** FONDECYT Regular 1231930
**PI:** Lorena Ortega
**Role:** Research Assistant · CIAE, Universidad de Chile ::: ::: ## Recent collaborations ::: {.project-grid} ::: {.project-card} 2026 ### Making Europe a global magnet for international students British Academy Pump Priming collaboration between UK and EU partners, led by Rachel Brooks at the University of Oxford. **Grant:** PPHE26\100097
**Role:** Research Assistant ::: ::: {.project-card} 2026 ### Relational opportunity structures in adolescence Examines how extracurricular activity contexts shape social status and peer-network dynamics. [Watch the network here](files/networks/popular_networks_combined_interactive.html){target="_blank"} **Role:** Visiting Doctoral Researcher
**Host:** Diego Palacios · Society and Health Research Centre, Universidad Mayor ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025-2026 ### From access to inclusion Research on cross-class dynamics in academically selective institutions, supported by a British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowship. **Grant:** PFSS25\250031
**PI:** Paulina Rodríguez · University of Oxford
**Role:** Research Assistant ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025-2026 ### STEM Gender Programme impact evaluation Impact evaluation with female 10th-grade students and STEM teachers for UNDP and Chile's Ministry of Education. **Grant:** UNDP-CHL-00141
**PI:** Pilar Reyes · CIAE, Universidad de Chile
**Role:** Research Assistant ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025-2026 ### Learning achievements of migrant students Research for Chile's Education Quality Assurance Agency on cultural, policy, and educational-practice factors that support migrant students' learning. **PI:** Lorena Ortega · CIAE, Universidad de Chile
**Role:** Research Assistant ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025-2026 ### Support and care networks among older adults A literature review focused on sibling bonds, funded through Universidad Mayor's Puente Funding Scheme. **PI:** Francisca Ortiz · Universidad Mayor
**Role:** Research Assistant ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025-2026 ### The EthOS Project A collaboration hosted by Durham University's Institute of Advanced Study. **PI:** Catherine Montgomery
**Role:** Research Assistant ::: ::: {.project-card} 2025 ### Isolation and social groups in a university community Research on group formation and isolation in higher education using social-network approaches. **Grant:** FONDECYT Postdoctoral 3250037
**Role:** Visiting Doctoral Researcher
**Host:** Alejandro Espinosa Rada · Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile ::: ::: ::: {.cta-panel} ## Earlier projects My earlier work includes gender gaps in mathematics, knowledge production in Latin American universities, teacher-student interaction networks, reader education, and social participation. The complete record is available in my [CV](files/Montero_CV.pdf){target="_blank"}. :::
